content: The Auto Repair Shop demo offers oil changes, brake inspections, tire rotations, battery diagnostics, and engine diagnostics.
Oil changes start at $65. Brake inspections start at $45. Tire rotations start at $35. Battery diagnostics start at $40. Engine diagnostics start at $95.
Auto Repair Shop demo hours are Monday through Friday from 7:30 AM to 6 PM and Saturday from 8 AM to 2 PM.
Auto repair appointments should be cancelled or rescheduled at least 24 hours in advance. Diagnostic appointments provide an estimate before repair work begins.
Oil changes usually take 30 to 45 minutes. Brake inspections usually take 45 minutes. Engine diagnostics usually take about one hour.
